inspection: All selected native act pages visually inspected for continuous readable printing, complete beginning and terminal closing/subscription; source OCR boundaries checked against them. No full lexical collation is claimed.
translation_identity: Historical anonymous English translation in the identified contemporary journal, separate from the adjacent Latin text.
exclusions: All preceding/following articles and Latin versions excluded from the English derivative; explicit running heads, isolated page numerals and scan watermark text excluded by frozen exact lines. The full historical OCR remains separately retained.
qualifications: OCR errors and line-end hyphen fragments retained.
